CHALDEAN-MISSING-001.say: Missing 1 is linked with little ego, low self-confidence, an introverted nature and difficulty sharing your experiences openly. It can also bring problems in certain careers.

CHALDEAN-MISSING-002.say: Missing 2 is linked with problems in love, less stability and patience, and difficulty following a routine. You may live in imagination and lack intuition and confidence.

CHALDEAN-MISSING-003.say: Missing 3 is linked with less grace of Guru and God, problems in promotion and growth, and weaker creative thinking and decisions. You may feel low in confidence and distracted.

CHALDEAN-MISSING-004.say: Missing 4 is linked with less financial stability and growth, more struggle and a lack of direction. Your intuition and thought power may be weaker, and you may be forgetful.

CHALDEAN-MISSING-005.say: Missing 5 is linked with less stability and confidence, trouble starting work, business losses and problems building your own house. Take care of stomach and back pain.

CHALDEAN-MISSING-006.say: Missing 6 is linked with less money and luxury, more struggle and few good friends. Family support may come late, and being introverted can cause problems in love.

CHALDEAN-MISSING-007.say: Missing 7 is linked with hurdles in work and studies, little family support and mental disturbance. You may see less success for the effort you put in.

CHALDEAN-MISSING-008.say: Missing 8 is linked with difficulty in financial decisions, low motivation, ups and downs and less perfection in work. Take care of your health and wealth.

CHALDEAN-MISSING-009.say: Missing 9 is linked with low energy and enthusiasm, weak willpower, ups and downs and less reputation. Take care to stay mindful of others' feelings.
